page_title: PSG 3-0 STR | PSG v Strasbourg 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+2' Nordi Mukiele (Paris SG) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90+1' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Cher Ndour (Paris SG) for his blatant foul.
85' Substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) on for Junior Mwanga.
82' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Vitinha is replaced by Cher Ndour (Paris SG).
82' The referee signals a substitution. Layvin Kurzawa (Paris SG) is brought on as a substitute for Carlos Soler.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Vitinha (Paris SG) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

77' 3 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the top left corner and makes it 3:0. Matz Sels was helpless.
75' The resulting set piece from Strasbourg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
73' Here is a change. Lebo Mothiba is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg).
72' Lucas Hernandez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nordi Mukiele (Paris SG).
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.
70' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' It's time for a substitution. Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) comes on in place of Goncalo Ramos.
66' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) replaces Bradley Barcola.
64' Looks like Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
64' An attempted cross from Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is cleared.
62' Substitution. Jessy Deminguet did his best and is replaced by Angelo (Strasbourg).
60' The game is interrupted as Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) is flagged offside.
59' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) is able to continue to play.
57' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) picks up an injury.
54' Vitinha (Paris SG) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
52' Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
50' Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul after Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
48' Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Vitinha (Paris SG) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
42' The ball possession is 75:25.
40' Vitinha (Paris SG) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
38' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' A cross from Danilo Pereira (Paris SG) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
33' Referee Bastien Dechepy points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Carlos Soler (Paris SG) goes wild in celebration.
32' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Paris SG players aren’t happy.
31' 2 - 0 Goal Carlos Soler (Paris SG)! Carlos Soler (Paris SG) was put through by Kylian Mbappe and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top right corner. 2:0.
29' Bradley Barcola (Paris SG) commits a rough foul. Bastien Dechepy stops the game and makes a call.
27' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

23' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Paris SG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
21' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
19' Danilo Pereira (Paris SG) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
17' Paris SG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
15' Celebrations are cut short for Strasbourg as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
14' Wait! Referee Bastien Dechepy has indicated he is going to review the Strasbourg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
13' Goal! Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Lucas Perrin and easily beat the keeper with a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 1:1.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
12' Strasbourg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' 1 - 0 Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) gives no chance to the goalkeeper with his perfectly executed penalty kick.
9' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
8' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastien Dechepy interrupted the game to signal a free kick. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Paris SG!
5' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
3' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Paris SG will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Bastien Dechepy.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
